definitions.gloss: purchase price; wholesale cost; cost price
definitions.explanation: The price at which a retailer or business buys goods from a supplier or wholesaler, before adding markup for resale. A fundamental concept in commerce and business.

examples.japanese: {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}が{上|あ}がった。
{仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}より{安|やす}く{売|う}ったら{赤字|あかじ}になる。
examples.english: If you sell below the purchase price, you'll be in the red.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}の{高騰|こうとう}で{仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}が{上昇|じょうしょう}し、{販売|はんばい}{価格|かかく}に{転嫁|てんか}せざるを{得|え}なくなった。
examples.english: Due to soaring raw material costs, the purchase prices rose and we had no choice but to pass the costs on to the selling price.

notes:
Compound of {仕入|しい}れ (purchasing, stocking) and {値|ね} (price). The price a business pays to acquire goods, as opposed to the selling price ({売|う}り{値|ね}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}が{上|あ}がる: the purchase price rises
- {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}が{下|さ}がる: the purchase price falls
- {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}で{売|う}る: to sell at cost
- {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}を{抑|おさ}える: to keep purchase costs down

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {原価|げんか}: cost price — the total cost including manufacturing and procurement
- {卸値|おろしね}: wholesale price — price at which wholesalers sell to retailers
- {売値|うりね}: selling price — the price at which goods are sold to customers
- {定価|ていか}: list price, retail price — the manufacturer's suggested price
